text.en: Language Models as Zero-Shot Planners is row 72 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Evaluation Analysis area.
text.zh: Language Models as Zero-Shot Planners 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 72 行，所属领域为“评测与分析”。

text.en: The annual table associates Language Models as Zero-Shot Planners with “Language Models as Zero-Shot Planners: Extracting Actionable Knowledge for Embodied Agents”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Language Models as Zero-Shot Planners 与论文《Language Models as Zero-Shot Planners: Extracting Actionable Knowledge for Embodied Agents》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Wenlong Huang, Deepak Pathak, Igor Mordatch”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Wenlong Huang（官方页拼写）、Deepak Pathak（官方页拼写）、Igor Mordatch（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Wenlong Huang, Deepak Pathak, Igor Mordatch”。
